data.why: the repo ships no example data, so a hand-built SDF with mass-diverse basic/acidic/amphoteric/salt-fragment/duplicate-ID/corrupted test records (matching the SAMPLE_ID/SMILES extraction the loader expects) and a matching optional 1536-well master map CSV were written to exercise the pooling engine end to end.

goals: Upload a compound library SDF and generate a 384-well pooling plate layout that maximizes mass diversity within each ionization polarity
Check which library compounds were predicted positive vs. negative mode and verify none fall below the minimum Δm/z separation threshold in a pool
Review and download the automation-ready source prep and assay run manifests (xlsx) and the Echo acoustic liquid handler transfer picklist (csv)
Open the self-contained interactive HTML plate map to click individual wells and inspect compound structures, masses, and target m/z values
Cross-reference an optional 1536-well master plate map against the new pools to generate a 1536-to-384 consolidation picklist
After a run, reconcile a post-run Echo exception/failed-transfer report against the source prep manifest to recompute DMSO back-flush volumes and regenerate corrected manifests

review.summary: The tree describes tab 1 accurately and with good evidence: setup, pooling, QC, export and the master-map check. It still needs fixing because two important outcomes (consolidation and duplicate merging) were lost to a test-data error that the tree blames on the app, the core polarity and stride engine has no feature, and the HTML map inspector and the post-run reconciler are missing even though the README and goals call them central.
